system.description:
The Anthem of Courage is a fierce song of hope that holds Elves steadfast against abominable foes. When properly sung, no Elf in the host will leave his station so long as the lord lives. Extra successes from the song are added as dice to Steel.

Obstacle: See Description. Companions, Ob 1. Squad, Ob 2. Company, Ob 3. Battalion, Ob 4. Army, Ob 5.

Actions: 20

Elven spell song: counts as a sorcerous skill for practice and learning; tests are always open-ended (natural magic); no tools, no FoRKs; causes wonderment. Root is Will unless otherwise noted.

Restrictions: Elves only

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 145
